title: Trajectory2Task: Training Robust Tool-Calling Agents with Synthesized Yet Verifiable Data for Complex User Intents
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical performance and robustness of tool-calling agents in complex user scenarios such as ambiguous or changing intents. It discusses policy constraints in a technical and business context (e.g., authentication for order cancellation) but does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
